function sql(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || String(value).trim() === '') return 'NULL';
  return "'" + String(value).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
}
const body = $json.body || $json;
const publicationJobId = String(body.publicationJobId || body.publication_job_id || '').trim();
const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
if (!uuidRegex.test(publicationJobId)) {
  return [{ json: { query: "SELECT false AS ok, 'publicationJobId is required' AS error;" } }];
}
const query = `
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS publication_job_events (
  event_id text PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text),
  publication_job_id uuid NOT NULL,
  event_type text NOT NULL,
  event_label text NOT NULL,
  event_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed',
  event_payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  error_message text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_publication_job_events_job_created
  ON publication_job_events (publication_job_id, created_at);
WITH job AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM publication_jobs
  WHERE publication_job_id = ${sql(publicationJobId)}::uuid
  LIMIT 1
), metadata_events AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    VALUES
      ('job-created', 'Publication job created', 'completed', (SELECT created_at FROM job), jsonb_build_object('status', (SELECT status FROM job)), NULL),
      ('brief-ready', 'Creative brief ready', 'completed', COALESCE(((SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'briefGeneratedAt')::timestamptz, (SELECT updated_at FROM job)), jsonb_build_object('provider', (SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'briefProvider'), NULL),
      ('prompt-ready', 'Prompt pack ready', 'completed', COALESCE(((SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'promptPackGeneratedAt')::timestamptz, (SELECT updated_at FROM job)), jsonb_build_object('assetType', (SELECT asset_type FROM job)), NULL),
      ('generation-submitted', 'Image generation submitted', 'completed', COALESCE(((SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'generationSubmittedAt')::timestamptz, (SELECT updated_at FROM job)), jsonb_build_object('generationJobId', (SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'generationJobId', 'provider', (SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'generationProvider'), NULL),
      ('generated-output-ingested', 'Generated image ingested', 'completed', COALESCE(((SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'generatedAssetReadyAt')::timestamptz, (SELECT updated_at FROM job)), jsonb_build_object('assetId', (SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'latestGeneratedAssetId', 'objectPath', (SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'latestGeneratedAssetObjectPath'), NULL),
      ('asset-selected', 'Publication asset selected', 'completed', COALESCE(((SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'selectedAssetAt')::timestamptz, (SELECT updated_at FROM job)), jsonb_build_object('assetId', (SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'selectedAssetId', 'objectPath', (SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'selectedAssetObjectPath'), NULL),
      ('copy-ready', 'Caption and copy ready', 'completed', COALESCE(((SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'copyPackGeneratedAt')::timestamptz, (SELECT updated_at FROM job)), jsonb_build_object('language', COALESCE((SELECT publishing_pack FROM job)->>'language', '')), NULL),
      ('ready-to-publish', 'Publishing pack exported', 'completed', COALESCE(((SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'publishingExportedAt')::timestamptz, (SELECT updated_at FROM job)), COALESCE((SELECT metadata FROM job)->'publishingExport', '{}'::jsonb), NULL),
      ('published', 'Publication marked as published', 'completed', COALESCE(((SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'publishedAt')::timestamptz, (SELECT updated_at FROM job)), COALESCE((SELECT metadata FROM job)->'publishedRecord', '{}'::jsonb), NULL),
      ('failed', 'Workflow error', 'failed', (SELECT updated_at FROM job), jsonb_build_object('status', (SELECT status FROM job)), (SELECT error_message FROM job))
  ) AS e(event_type, event_label, event_status, created_at, event_payload, error_message)
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job)
    AND CASE event_type
      WHEN 'job-created' THEN true
      WHEN 'brief-ready' THEN (SELECT brief FROM job) IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 'prompt-ready' THEN (SELECT prompt_pack FROM job) IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 'generation-submitted' THEN (SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'generationJobId' IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 'generated-output-ingested' THEN (SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'latestGeneratedAssetId' IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 'asset-selected' THEN (SELECT metadata FROM job)->>'selectedAssetId' IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 'copy-ready' THEN (SELECT publishing_pack FROM job) IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 'ready-to-publish' THEN (SELECT metadata FROM job)->'publishingExport' IS NOT NULL
      WHEN 'published' THEN (SELECT metadata FROM job)->'publishedRecord' IS NOT NULL OR (SELECT status FROM job) = 'published'
      WHEN 'failed' THEN (SELECT status FROM job) = 'failed' OR COALESCE((SELECT error_message FROM job), '') <> ''
      ELSE false
    END
), persisted_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_type,
    event_label,
    event_status,
    created_at,
    event_payload,
    error_message
  FROM publication_job_events
  WHERE publication_job_id = ${sql(publicationJobId)}::uuid
), all_events AS (
  SELECT * FROM metadata_events
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM persisted_events
), ordered_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (event_type, event_label, created_at)
    event_type,
    event_label,
    event_status,
    created_at,
    event_payload,
    error_message
  FROM all_events
  ORDER BY event_type, event_label, created_at, event_status
), next_action AS (
  SELECT CASE (SELECT status FROM job)
    WHEN 'draft' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'generate-brief', 'label', 'Generate brief', 'description', 'Generate or paste the creative brief for this publication.')
    WHEN 'brief-ready' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'generate-prompt-pack', 'label', 'Generate prompt pack', 'description', 'Create the Comfy-ready prompt pack from the approved brief.')
    WHEN 'prompt-ready' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'generate-images', 'label', 'Generate images', 'description', 'Submit the prompt pack to Comfy Cloud.')
    WHEN 'generating' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'ingest-output', 'label', 'Ingest Comfy output', 'description', 'Wait for the generated image, then paste the Comfy output URL.')
    WHEN 'review-ready' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'select-asset', 'label', 'Select publication asset', 'description', 'Review the generated image and select it for this publication job.')
    WHEN 'assets-ready' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'generate-copy-pack', 'label', 'Generate copy', 'description', 'Generate or edit the caption and publishing copy.')
    WHEN 'copy-ready' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'export-pack', 'label', 'Export publishing pack', 'description', 'Prepare the image URL, caption, hashtags, and manual publishing instructions.')
    WHEN 'ready-to-publish' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'publish-manually', 'label', 'Publish manually and record URL', 'description', 'Post from the Instagram account, then mark the job as published.')
    WHEN 'published' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'complete', 'label', 'Complete', 'description', 'This publication has been recorded as published.')
    WHEN 'failed' THEN jsonb_build_object('action', 'review-error', 'label', 'Review error', 'description', 'Read the error, fix the cause, and retry the failed step.')
    ELSE jsonb_build_object('action', 'inspect-status', 'label', 'Inspect status', 'description', 'Review the current job status and continue from the matching section.')
  END AS value
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job)
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job) AS ok,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job) THEN NULL ELSE 'Publication job not found' END AS error,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job) THEN jsonb_build_object(
    'publicationJobId', (SELECT publication_job_id FROM job),
    'status', (SELECT status FROM job),
    'errorMessage', (SELECT error_message FROM job),
    'nextAction', (SELECT value FROM next_action),
    'events', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'eventType', event_type,
        'label', event_label,
        'status', event_status,
        'createdAt', created_at,
        'payload', event_payload,
        'errorMessage', error_message
      ) ORDER BY created_at ASC NULLS LAST)
      FROM ordered_events
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) ELSE NULL END AS timeline;
`;
return [{ json: { query } }];
